wechat.title: WeChat alerts
wechat.description: Get the requests waiting for your signature and the outcome of your own requests on WeChat.
wechat.connectedHint: Approval alerts reach your WeChat through the PushPlus official account.
wechat.step1: On your phone, open <link>pushplus.plus</link> and sign in with WeChat (scan the QR code and follow the “pushplus 推送加” official account).
wechat.step2: In the “一对一推送” (one-to-one) menu, copy your token.
wechat.step3: Paste the token here and click Connect — a test message arrives on your WeChat.
wechat.privacy: Alerts go through PushPlus, an external service. They only carry the request number, title and link — no amounts.
wechat.connectedToast: WeChat connected. Check the test message.
